pages.title: The Three Commands
pages.text: Type these in chat any time — they print your live progression:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex balance$() — your token pool vs the next tier's threshold.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex bosses$() — your boss-rush clear, per tier.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex submit$() — bank the eligible materials you're carrying into tokens.$(br2)Full detail: $(l:icraft:progression/check_your_standing)Check Your Standing$(/l).

The book can't print live numbers — these commands are how you ask the Codex where you stand.$(br2)Prefer clicking? The $(bold)Submit$() buttons in the Engineering and Magic Crafting quest groups ($(k:heracles.open_quests)) do the same cap-safe banking as $(bold)/icraft codex submit$().$(br2)$(bold)Now run /icraft codex balance.$()
